# Zune

Zune theme by **[namastecoconut-imagined](https://github.com/namastecoconut-imagined/diskos-disco-zune/commits?author=namastecoconut-imagined)**, adapted into Disco with a readability and controls polish pass by zmd22. The original theme supplies the design direction: bold lowercase type, deep black, a personal accent and a flowing home menu. Open Sans retains its SIL Open Font License. Unofficial fan theme; not affiliated with Microsoft.

Choose **Settings → Display → Theme → Zune**. Zune is dark; set its accent in the theme’s colour settings. The [website walkthrough](https://zmd22.github.io/diskos-disco/#zune) previews the screens in several colours.

## Everyday navigation

Swipe up from the bottom to return Home with Now Playing focused. Its subtext shows the track and artist. Browse the menu to open your music, queue, settings and other destinations.

The small four-square outline on the edge is your main shortcut; its upper-right square uses the accent. Under **Display → Music screen → Zune**, set **Main icon**, **Main icon double-tap** and **Main icon hold** independently. The unused Now Playing style setting is no longer shown for Zune.

Music leaves more room for the track title and artist by moving the album cover partly beyond the left edge. Duration and audio details sit together. The volume overlay uses your accent and captures touch so adjusting volume cannot seek the progress ring underneath.

## Immersive 3.0

Open Immersive from your chosen shortcut. Vinyl, CD and Cover share the spinning-disc entrance and exit, including in Zune. Tap the artwork to reveal the transport overlay: title, artist, elapsed time, previous, play/pause and next. Use Back to return to Music. Animations follows the global setting.

## Library, Quick Settings and stats

Choose **List**, **Wall** or **Coverflow** for Album View. Swipe the library header to change category; row swipes remain selection gestures. Small, Medium and Large choose different library text sizes; Medium matches the previous default. Only the selected overflowing folder title scrolls horizontally.

Quick Settings has six configurable actions. Visible track information scrolls continuously; pause/resume feedback remains centred. Listening Stats follows the theme, with readable headings and details; content lists can be scrolled manually, while labels avoid vertical marquees.
